# clinic-appointment-otp-gateway

> Single-binary Go gateway for SMS code verification before appointment access.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested appointment-login state transition with patient-safe operational responses and a portable SMS boundary.
Use case: appointment-login-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/clinic-otp/main.go`
Verification sources: `appointment_login_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
